'''Cory Degroot''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Denver DPC Episode I booster draft]] on 1 September 2001 with Random Pile of DS Cards, according to Chris Fanchi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2937">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-episode-i-sealed-deck-tacticon-denverd2937/ episode-i-sealed-deck-tacticon-denver], DeckTech (Chris "Artwo" Fanchi, 5 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-episode-i-sealed-deck-tacticon-denverd2937/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
